title: Index universe equal-weight full snapshot
description: Resolve an owner-owned universe, validate complete membership and pricing, and target an equal weight against a concrete budget.

universe.description: Name of the owner-owned universe to rebalance (resolved to an immutable membership revision).

budget_inr.description: Total capital the equal-weight target is built against, in INR.

cash_buffer_pct.description: Fraction of the budget deliberately left uninvested.

product.description: Frozen product for every member leg.

exchange.description: Exchange every member is quoted on.

no_change_tolerance.description: Per-member quantity difference below which the book is considered unchanged.

deadline_seconds.description: How long the child waits for an owner decision on an approval-based request.
